fullCommand:
set -eu
trap 'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /work/full-output/memory-events.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /work/full-output/memory-peak.txt' EXIT
cargo fmt --all --check > /work/full-output/fmt.log 2>&1
cargo test --offline --locked --all-features --lib --bins --tests --examples -j 1 > /work/full-output/full-suite.log 2>&1
cargo clippy --offline --locked --all-features --all-targets -j 1 > /work/full-output/clippy.log 2>&1
cargo build --offline --locked --bin recalld -j 1 > /work/full-output/bin-build.log 2>&1
python3 scripts/public-conformance.py --inside --fixture-version 3 > /work/full-output/public.log 2>&1
python3 scripts/test_public_conformance.py > /work/full-output/runner-tests.log 2>&1
